Rina (Design): Quick sync on batch vectors UX. Main items: heatmap contrast, keyboard nav inside preview, and CSV export delimiter choices for international users. Figma: https://figma.com/ourfile :mag:

Sam K (Frontend): Current heatmap uses low-contrast midtones. Suggest increasing saturation for mid-range and adding a hatched pattern overlay for users with color deficiencies.

Liam (A11y): Pattern overlay 👍. Also need aria-labels for each heatmap cell: e.g., "Row 4, score 0.62, medium relevance". Make grid role=grid and support arrow-key navigation.

Priya (Product): CSV issue: customers in EU open CSVs with semicolons. Can we add explicit delimiter options in the export modal (Comma, Semicolon, TSV) and default to Comma but suggest Semicolon for some locales?

Noah (Data): Backend can accept a `delimiter` param. We can implement `delimiter=auto` that chooses semicolon when Accept-Language indicates `de|fr|es`. But front-end should expose choices as radio buttons.

Sam K (Frontend): Plan: export modal will have radio: [Comma (CSV)] [Semicolon (CSV - Excel)] [Tab (TSV)]. Default = Comma with small helper: "If columns appear merged, try semicolon or TSV". Also add a checkbox: "Include similarity score and rank" (default checked).

Rina (Design): Copy tweak for helper: "If your spreadsheet merges columns, try semicolon or TSV". Short and clear. For heatmap legend, show both color and textual buckets (High/Med/Low) plus numeric thresholds.

Liam (A11y): For modal focus: trap focus while open, Escape closes modal, and focus must return to the toolbar button that opened it. Use aria-modal=true and aria-describedby for helper text.

Noah (Data): CSV columns suggested: id,query,match,score,bucket_label,model_version. Product asked for user-friendly headings; we can map machine names to friendly labels in a tooltip.

Priya (Product): Approve columns but change `score` -> `similarity_score` for clarity in exports and keep `relevance_rank` instead of `rank`. Also include a note in export modal: "Score ranges 0-1; higher means more relevant".

Sam K (Frontend): Implementation notes: heatmap cell tooltips will be lazy-rendered to avoid DOM bloat. Keyboard grid navigation will be implemented with roving tabindex. I'll add an accessibility demo beforehand. Also will wire API `delimiter` and `fields` params and link to INF-4890.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for branch/heatmap-accessibility on Friday 09:00 UTC.

Rina (Design): Action items: Sam to prototype delimiter UI + focus behavior, Liam to draft aria strings and a11y copy, Noah to confirm CSV naming and `delimiter` behavior, Priya to sign off on product copy, Rina to update Figma legend and microcopy. Back next week to review canary results. :+1:
